title: Every readiness and connection label says only what it checked, in one vocabulary
acceptance: The Live card music line no longer says "Music ready" or "a music service Live can play" when it has only checked for provider links.
Account Apple Music playback no longer shows "Authorized" from stored connection data alone; it says what is known and that Live checks this browser (D24).
The Live header count says what it counts.
Classes list labels name the actual gap ("2 blocks empty", "1 song outside the plan") instead of one "Needs music" for four different states, and a tempo-only gap does not read like a blocker.
Connection states and actions use one word each across Music, Account and preflight ("Session expired"/"Reconnect needed"/"Reconnect"; "Manage" vs "Manage connections").
The new vocabulary is written into the design canon; iOS follows the canon wording.
Judgment, if the owner accepts it: Classes home surfaces one next class and what is left on it.

evidence.summary: The music dimension checks only providerRefs.length; its detail text claims "Live can play", which the file header says is preflight's job. Checked on main c9b89a7.
providerCapabilityTruth labels playback "Authorized" from a stored connection with playback scope; Live checks MusicKit isAuthorized in the current browser. Checked on main c9b89a7.
readinessLabel maps four plan and music states to "Needs music"; every non-Ready label gets the same dot. Checked on main c9b89a7.
2026-10-28 owner UX audit of production: Top priorities 3, 4 and 5, cross-cutting theme 1, and the matching Classes, Live and Account rows. Browser evidence; not re-observed at intake.
Final review of #677 corrected file pointers, record links and the design system 10 §1a reading.
Owner set Ready 2026-10-31 in the Neo session ("Yes" to "Should RF-134 go Ready for the Neo?"), after RF-166 merged (#682, c0b60d4).

Labels say what they checked (RF-131 answer 2a). readiness.ts music: "Music linked on every track" / "Every track is linked to a music service. Live checks playback before you start." (no "Live can play"). providers.ts Account playback: "Linked · Live checks this browser" instead of "Authorized" (D24). Live queue count: "N of M classes can run live: every track has a length." Classes row: class-scaffold.ts planGap gives each plan gap a short label from the same derivation as its lead ("2 blocks empty", "1 song outside the plan", "1 block over time"), carried as ClassNextStep.label; readinessLabel uses it and maps the rest to "No tracks", "Music not linked", "Needs duration", "Needs cues", "Needs effort" (no single "Needs music"; tempo is not a list label since RF-166). Connection words: the expired Music chip and Account card say "Session expired" (not "Reconnect"/"Expired"); "Reconnect" is only a button; Account "Manage" is "Manage connections". Design system 9.8 now holds the vocabulary table and the readiness rule. Considered and not changed: the Account capability ledger keeps its next-action hints ("Reconnect account", "Connect account") because a state word there repeats the row state mark.

New planGap label tests; ClassesHome "names the exact plan gap on the row (RF-134)"; readinessLabel table updated; providers, music-library, ProviderCapabilityLedger and Dashboard tests updated to the new words. Full local gate green on 8bc753c, 2026-10-31: web 1616, api 636, e2e 2 passed.

iOS: the vocabulary lives in design system 9.8, which iOS reads from the web canon; ritmofit-design-system.md is not in the iOS web-contract snapshot, so no iOS PR is required now. iOS adopts the wording when it builds these surfaces.

resolution: Readiness and connection labels say only what they checked, in one vocabulary written into design system 9.8 (#683). The optional judgment item (Classes home surfaces one next class) was not taken: its acceptance line is conditional on owner acceptance, which was not given; RF-171 still holds the other RF-133 review items.
